plaatsen.tekst: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine
The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able

Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep
That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider
I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden
He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
